notes.title: LEADERBOARDS UPDATE - V1.05
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176543/40e79211d02f6263350ebd39896d5b7c80c6cfa9.png[/img]

[b][i]Due to unauthorized experimentation around the lab, your assigned SUB was fitted out with a top of the line yet unnecessary receiving and uploading system. You can now track your abilities online across the entire world with Steam leaderboards! How brilliant![/i][/b]

[b]Version 1.05 Changelog[/b]

[b]New stuff[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Leaderboards*
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The shield upgrade now protects against boss attacks
[*] Options now automatically save 
[*] Better and more efficient storing of score data (due to this, highscores have been erased, although progress is still saved)
[*] Limited the maximum amount of explosion particles
[*] Elite bosses are now more common at higher difficulties
[*] Slightly lowered chances of a tornado
[*] Slightly reduce hard mode difficulty 
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some upgrade prices being incorrect
[*] Fixed some objects and boss’ not pausing correctly
[*] The mine upgrade no longer spawns mines when the game is paused
[*] Spelling fixes (go me)
[*] A few bugs fixed with the tornado
[/list]

[i]Next update: Something from the deep…[/i]

[i]*If you experience any problems with uploading or viewing highscores/leaderboards, please leave a comment below! Thanks lots :)[/i]
